curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover obeying officers, the headlight and dimming rules, front light colors, loads, littering and funerals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each headlight, lighting and load rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on headlight times, dimming and lighting rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain minimum speeds and slow-moving vehicles, the Basic Speed Rule and the posted highway and interstate limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each speed rule and limit.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on safe and legal speed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain when school and work zone limits apply and the penalties for speeding in them.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on school and work zone speed rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on school and work zone speeding.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach braking with and without anti-lock brakes, then following distance and stopping distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on braking habits, the two-second rule and stopping distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on braking and following distance.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show where and how to stop at signs, behind other cars and at railroad crossings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on stopping rules and railroad crossing rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on stopping and railroad crossings.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain when to stop for school buses and how transit buses differ.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on school bus lights, stops, penalties and divided highways.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on stopping for buses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach intersection habits, then who must yield to pedestrians and other vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on intersection habits and each yielding rule.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover yielding to emergency vehicles, police stops, the Move Over Law and turning and signaling.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on emergency vehicles, traffic stops, Move Over and turns.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on emergency vehicles, stops and turns.
